tagline.en: The engineer who took AMD from under $2 a share to a trillion-dollar AI chipmaker
tagline.zh: 把 AMD 从不到 2 美元一股带到万亿美元 AI 芯片公司的工程师

label.en: Savings and equity from Texas Instruments, IBM and Freescale (estimate)
label.zh: 德州仪器、IBM、飞思卡尔时期的积蓄与股权（估算）

label.en: Cash from AMD pay and sold AMD shares, after tax (estimate)
label.zh: AMD 薪酬及售出 AMD 股票所得现金，税后（估算）
AMD 持股（已持有股票 + 可行权期权）

t.en: Tainan to Queens
t.zh: 从台南到皇后区

desc.en: Born in Taiwan, raised in New York City, drawn to engineering early and admitted to the Bronx High School of Science
desc.zh: 出生在台湾，在纽约长大，从小喜欢动手做工程，考入布朗克斯科学高中

t.en: MIT years
t.zh: 麻省理工岁月

desc.en: Three electrical-engineering degrees at MIT, ending with a doctorate on advanced transistors
desc.zh: 在麻省理工拿到电气工程的三个学位，最后以先进晶体管研究获得博士学位

t.en: IBM and Freescale
t.zh: IBM 与飞思卡尔

desc.en: Copper interconnects and the Cell chip at IBM, then her first executive roles at Freescale
desc.zh: 在 IBM 做铜互连和 Cell 芯片，随后在飞思卡尔第一次担任高管

t.en: Joining AMD
t.zh: 加入 AMD

desc.en: Arrives as AMD nears collapse, wins the game-console contracts and is made chief executive within three years
desc.zh: 在 AMD 濒临崩溃时到任，拿下游戏主机订单，不到三年出任首席执行官

t.en: The turnaround
t.zh: 绝地翻身

desc.en: Bets the company on the Zen design; Ryzen and EPYC bring AMD back against Intel
desc.zh: 把公司押在 Zen 架构上；Ryzen 和 EPYC 让 AMD 重新与英特尔抗衡

t.en: Bigger than Intel
t.zh: 超越英特尔

desc.en: Buys Xilinx, becomes chair, and sees AMD pass Intel in market value before a PC slump halves the stock
desc.zh: 收购赛灵思、出任董事长，AMD 市值超过英特尔，随后 PC 寒冬让股价腰斩

t.en: AI challenger
t.zh: AI 挑战者

desc.en: Takes on Nvidia with Instinct accelerators, signs OpenAI and Meta, and leads AMD past $1 trillion
desc.zh: 用 Instinct 加速器挑战英伟达，签下 OpenAI 和 Meta，带领 AMD 市值突破 1 万亿美元

t.en: Born in Tainan, Taiwan
t.zh: 出生于台湾台南

summary.en: Lisa Su was born in Tainan, Taiwan. She moved to the United States with her parents at the age of three and grew up in Queens, New York, where she took apart and repaired remote-controlled cars as a child.
summary.zh: 苏姿丰出生在台湾台南。三岁时随父母移居美国，在纽约皇后区长大，小时候就喜欢把遥控车拆开再修好。

why.en: Starting point, not scored. Human capital starts below the U.S. average and steps up once she is growing up in New York (the year of the move is approximate, so it is not a separate event).
why.zh: 起点事件，不计分。人力资本初始值低于美国平均水平，到纽约生活后上调一档（移居的具体年份只能大致确定，所以不单列事件）。

src.name: MIT News · Lisa Su to deliver the 2026 Commencement address (2025-12-11)

t.en: Graduates from the Bronx High School of Science and enters MIT
t.zh: 从布朗克斯科学高中毕业，进入麻省理工学院

summary.en: She finished high school at the Bronx High School of Science, one of New York City's selective public schools, and started at MIT that autumn, choosing electrical engineering.
summary.zh: 她从纽约市的重点公立学校布朗克斯科学高中毕业，同年秋天进入麻省理工学院，选了电气工程专业。

why.en: An education step: the human-capital target rises on entry to a top engineering school. Only the year is known, so the date is year precision.
why.zh: 学历台阶：进入顶尖工科院校，人力资本目标值上调。只能确认年份，因此日期精度为“年”。

src.name: Wikipedia · Bronx High School of Science

t.en: Earns a PhD in electrical engineering from MIT and joins Texas Instruments
t.zh: 获得麻省理工电气工程博士学位，加入德州仪器

summary.en: After a bachelor's degree in 1990 and a master's in 1991, she completed her MIT doctorate in 1994 with research on silicon-on-insulator transistors. The same year she took her first industry job at Texas Instruments.
summary.zh: 继 1990 年本科、1991 年硕士之后，她在 1994 年完成麻省理工的博士学业，研究方向是绝缘体上硅（SOI）晶体管。同年她进入德州仪器，开始第一份业界工作。

why.en: The main education step: the human-capital target moves to the level of a strong technical doctorate (about $1.5 million). Savings from her first salary start the financial line; the amounts are estimates.
why.zh: 最主要的学历台阶：人力资本目标值升到“名校技术博士”的水平（约 150 万美元）。第一份工资带来的积蓄让金融资本曲线起步，金额为估算。

src.name: MIT News · Lisa Su to deliver the 2026 Commencement address (2025-12-11)

t.en: Joins IBM as a research staff member in device physics
t.zh: 加入 IBM，任器件物理研究员

summary.en: After less than a year at Texas Instruments she moved to IBM's research organization, where she worked on semiconductor devices and later rose to vice president of the company's semiconductor research and development center.
summary.zh: 在德州仪器工作不到一年后，她转到 IBM 的研究部门从事半导体器件工作，后来升任 IBM 半导体研发中心副总裁。

why.en: The start of twelve years at IBM. A career step with no reputation effect yet; savings and IBM equity are estimated in the private line.
why.zh: IBM 十二年生涯的起点。属于职业台阶，暂无口碑效应；积蓄和 IBM 股权按估算计入非上市资产。

t.en: IBM brings copper-interconnect chips to market
t.zh: IBM 铜互连芯片投产

summary.en: IBM brought to market chips that used copper instead of aluminum for their internal wiring, a technology it had announced the year before, which made them up to about 20% faster. Su played an important part in working out how to keep copper from contaminating the devices during manufacturing.
summary.zh: IBM 把前一年宣布的铜互连技术推向市场：芯片内部连线用铜代替铝，速度最高提升约 20%。苏姿丰在解决“制造过程中铜污染器件”这一难题上起了重要作用。

why.en: The technical achievement that made her name inside the industry: +1% on the reputation coefficient and a first small rise in the media baseline. Only the year is certain.
why.zh: 这是让她在业内出名的技术成果：口碑系数 +1%，媒体热度基线第一次小幅上调。只能确认年份。

t.en: Serves as technical assistant to IBM CEO Lou Gerstner, then founds Emerging Products
t.zh: 担任 IBM CEO 郭士纳的技术助理，随后创建新兴产品部门

summary.en: She spent a year as technical assistant to IBM's chief executive, then set up and ran the Emerging Products group. In that role she represented IBM in the joint project with Sony and Toshiba that produced the Cell processor used in the PlayStation 3.
summary.zh: 她做了一年 IBM 首席执行官的技术助理，之后创建并领导新兴产品部门。在这个岗位上，她代表 IBM 参与了与索尼、东芝的合作项目，这个项目的成果就是后来用在 PlayStation 3 上的 Cell 处理器。

why.en: The move from research into business leadership raises the human-capital target. The Cell project also gave her the game-console relationships that mattered later at AMD. Dated to the year of the assistant role; the Cell work ran over the following years.
why.zh: 从研究岗位转向业务管理，人力资本目标值上调。Cell 项目也让她积累了游戏主机方面的人脉，后来在 AMD 派上了用场。日期取担任助理的年份，Cell 项目在此后几年间展开。

t.en: Named to MIT Technology Review's list of top young innovators
t.zh: 入选《麻省理工科技评论》青年创新者榜单

summary.en: MIT Technology Review included her in its TR100 list of leading innovators under 35, citing her work on new low-power chip products at IBM.
summary.zh: 《麻省理工科技评论》把她选入 35 岁以下创新者 TR100 榜单，主要依据是她在 IBM 开发低功耗芯片新产品的工作。

why.en: A footnote-level honor: +1% on the reputation coefficient. Sources give both 2001 and 2002; the magazine's own list says 2002.
why.zh: 脚注级别的荣誉：口碑系数 +1%。资料中 2001 和 2002 两种说法都有，杂志自己的榜单页面写的是 2002 年。

src.name: MIT Technology Review · Innovators Under 35: Lisa Su

t.en: Joins Freescale Semiconductor as chief technology officer
t.zh: 加入飞思卡尔半导体，任首席技术官

summary.en: She left IBM to become chief technology officer of Freescale, the former Motorola chip unit then owned by private-equity firms. From September 2008 she ran its networking and multimedia business, and she stayed until the end of 2011, the year the company returned to the stock market.
summary.zh: 她离开 IBM，出任飞思卡尔的首席技术官——这家公司原是摩托罗拉的芯片部门，当时由私募基金持有。2008 年 9 月起她转而负责网络与多媒体业务，一直做到 2011 年底；飞思卡尔也在 2011 年重新上市。

why.en: Her first C-level job and first full business unit, so the human-capital target rises to about $6 million. Her Freescale pay and equity were never disclosed in detail; the private line uses a rough estimate.
why.zh: 第一次进入最高管理层，也第一次独立掌管完整的业务部门，人力资本目标值升到约 600 万美元。她在飞思卡尔的薪酬和股权没有详细披露，非上市资产只是粗略估算。

t.en: Joins AMD as senior vice president and general manager, Global Business Units
t.zh: 加入 AMD，任高级副总裁兼全球事业部总经理

summary.en: AMD announced her hiring in December 2011 and she started on January 3, 2012, reporting to chief executive Rory Read and running the company's product businesses. Two weeks later she received her first equity: about 717,000 stock options and 299,000 restricted stock units.
summary.zh: AMD 在 2011 年 12 月宣布聘用她，她于 2012 年 1 月 3 日到任，向首席执行官罗瑞·里德汇报，负责公司的各产品事业部。两周后她拿到第一批股权：约 71.7 万份期权和 29.9 万股限制性股票。

why.en: The decision that defines the rest of her life, so it is one of the few magnitude-5 events. From this day part of her financial capital is priced from the AMD quote. The ownership fraction counts shares she owns plus options she can already exercise, as reported in AMD proxy statements; unvested grants are not counted, so the line starts near zero.
why.zh: 这个决定塑造了她此后的人生，因此是少数几个 5 级事件之一。从这一天起，她的一部分金融资本按 AMD 股价计价。持股比例的口径是：已持有的股票加上已可行权的期权（取自 AMD 历年委托书）；未归属的授予不计入，所以曲线几乎从零起步。

fin.en: AMD closed at $5.48 that day. Her counted stake was close to zero.
fin.zh: 当天 AMD 收于 5.48 美元。按上述口径，她的持股几乎为零。

src.name: AMD · Press release: AMD to appoint Dr. Lisa Su (2011-12-15)

t.en: AMD shares close at $1.86, the low point of the decade
t.zh: AMD 股价收于 1.86 美元，为十年最低

summary.en: Ten months after she arrived, AMD stock closed at $1.86, down about two thirds since January, as PC sales fell and the company kept losing money. Investors openly questioned whether AMD could survive.
summary.zh: 她到任十个月后，AMD 股价收于 1.86 美元，比年初跌去约三分之二。当时个人电脑销量下滑，公司持续亏损，投资者公开质疑 AMD 能否活下去。

why.en: Fully priced by the market, so no reputation shock (rep = 0). Her own stake was still tiny, so her wealth barely moved; the event matters as the baseline against which the turnaround is measured.
why.zh: 完全由市场定价，不额外扣口碑（rep = 0）。她当时的持股还很少，个人财富几乎不受影响；这个事件的意义在于，它是衡量后来那场翻身仗的起点。

t.en: PlayStation 4 launches on AMD chips, followed a week later by Xbox One
t.zh: PlayStation 4 搭载 AMD 芯片上市，一周后 Xbox One 跟进

summary.en: Sony's PlayStation 4 went on sale in North America with a custom AMD processor, and Microsoft's Xbox One followed on November 22. Su, who ran AMD's business units, played a prominent part in winning both designs, which gave the company steady income outside the PC market.
summary.zh: 索尼 PlayStation 4 在北美开售，用的是 AMD 定制处理器；微软 Xbox One 于 11 月 22 日跟进。当时负责 AMD 各事业部的苏姿丰在拿下这两份订单的过程中起了重要作用，让公司在个人电脑之外有了一块稳定的收入。

why.en: The revenue shows up in the share price. The small +1% is for the diversification strategy she was credited with: non-PC products went from about 10% of sales in 2012 to about 40% by early 2015.
why.zh: 收入已反映在股价里。口碑系数小幅 +1%，对应外界归功于她的多元化战略：非 PC 产品占销售额的比例从 2012 年的约 10% 升到 2015 年初的约 40%。

t.en: Named president and chief executive officer of AMD
t.zh: 出任 AMD 总裁兼首席执行官

summary.en: AMD's board appointed her president and chief executive, effective immediately, in place of Rory Read. She had been chief operating officer since July. The stock closed at $3.28 that day and fell about 10% the next day; the whole company was worth less than $3 billion.
summary.zh: AMD 董事会任命她为总裁兼首席执行官，即日生效，接替罗瑞·里德。此前她自 7 月起担任首席运营官。当天股价收于 3.28 美元，次日下跌约 10%；整家公司的市值不到 30 亿美元。

why.en: Magnitude 5: the job she is known for. Human capital steps up to the level of a public-company CEO. The +2% on the reputation coefficient is modest because few people at the time expected the turnaround to work.
why.zh: 5 级事件：她最为人所知的职位。人力资本跃升到上市公司 CEO 的水平。口碑系数只 +2%，因为当时很少有人相信她能把公司救回来。

fin.en: Her counted stake was about 0.2% of AMD, worth roughly $5 million.
fin.zh: 按口径计算，她当时持有 AMD 约 0.2%，价值约 500 万美元。

src.name: AMD · Press release: AMD appoints Dr. Lisa Su as president and CEO

t.en: Announces a $293 million server-chip licensing venture in China; shares jump 52%
t.zh: 宣布在中国成立 2.93 亿美元的服务器芯片授权合资公司，股价大涨 52%

summary.en: Alongside first-quarter results, AMD said it would license processor technology to a joint venture with a Chinese investment group, THATIC, for $293 million in milestone payments plus royalties. The stock rose 52% the next day to $3.99, one of the biggest one-day gains in its history.
summary.zh: 在发布一季度财报的同时，AMD 宣布把处理器技术授权给与中国投资机构天津海光（THATIC）成立的合资公司，可按进度获得 2.93 亿美元授权费，另有版税。次日股价上涨 52%，收于 3.99 美元，是公司历史上最大的单日涨幅之一。

why.en: Fully priced by the market (rep = 0). It was the first sign that investors believed the company would stay solvent long enough to ship its new Zen processors.
why.zh: 完全由市场定价（rep = 0）。这是投资者第一次相信，公司能撑到新一代 Zen 处理器上市。

src.name: AMD · Press release: 2016 first quarter results

t.en: Ryzen 7 desktop processors go on sale, built on the new Zen core
t.zh: 基于全新 Zen 核心的 Ryzen 7 桌面处理器上市

summary.en: AMD released its Ryzen 7 chips, the first products based on the Zen design that the company had been developing for about four years. For the first time in a decade AMD had desktop processors that could compete with Intel's best on performance.
summary.zh: AMD 推出 Ryzen 7 处理器，这是公司花了大约四年研发的 Zen 架构的第一批产品。十年来 AMD 第一次拥有在性能上能与英特尔高端产品抗衡的桌面处理器。

why.en: Magnitude 5: the product the turnaround is remembered for. The revenue is in the share price, which had already risen about fivefold in the year before launch. The +4% on the reputation coefficient is for delivering a long, risky engineering bet on schedule.
why.zh: 5 级事件：这场翻身仗最具代表性的产品。收入已反映在股价里——发布前一年股价已经涨了约五倍。口碑系数 +4%，是因为她把一场周期长、风险高的工程豪赌按时兑现了。

t.en: Launches EPYC server processors and returns to the data center
t.zh: 发布 EPYC 服务器处理器，重返数据中心

summary.en: At an event in Austin, AMD launched the EPYC 7000 series, server chips with up to 32 cores, with HPE, Dell and other large server makers announcing systems. AMD's share of the server market had fallen to almost nothing before this.
summary.zh: 在奥斯汀的发布会上，AMD 推出最多 32 核的 EPYC 7000 系列服务器芯片，惠普企业、戴尔等大型服务器厂商同步发布了新机型。在此之前，AMD 在服务器市场的份额几乎归零。

why.en: The start of the business that later became AMD's largest. The value arrives slowly through the share price; +2% on the reputation coefficient for re-entering a market most analysts had written off.
why.zh: 这是后来成为 AMD 最大业务的起点。价值通过股价慢慢体现；重新打入多数分析师已经放弃的市场，口碑系数 +2%。

src.name: AMD · Press release: EPYC datacenter processor launches

t.en: Ryzen 3000 goes on sale, putting AMD ahead of Intel in manufacturing technology
t.zh: Ryzen 3000 上市，AMD 在制造工艺上领先英特尔

summary.en: AMD started selling Ryzen 3000 desktop chips based on the Zen 2 design and made by TSMC on a 7-nanometer process, while Intel was still struggling to move beyond 14 nanometers. Matching server chips followed in August.
summary.zh: AMD 开始销售基于 Zen 2 架构、由台积电用 7 纳米工艺代工的 Ryzen 3000 桌面处理器，而英特尔当时仍难以走出 14 纳米。配套的服务器芯片在 8 月跟进。

why.en: The market share gains are in the stock. +2% on the reputation coefficient for the earlier decision to move production to TSMC, which paid off here.
why.zh: 市场份额的增长已体现在股价里。口碑系数 +2%，对应她此前把生产转向台积电的决定——这一步在这里得到了回报。

t.en: First woman to top the Associated Press survey of CEO pay
t.zh: 成为首位登顶美联社 CEO 薪酬榜的女性

summary.en: The Associated Press and Equilar reported that her 2019 pay package, valued at $58.5 million, was the largest among S&P 500 chief executives, the first time a woman led the survey. Most of it was a one-time stock award tied to performance targets.
summary.zh: 美联社与 Equilar 的调查显示，她 2019 年的薪酬方案价值 5850 万美元，在标普 500 公司首席执行官中排名第一，这是该榜单首次由女性居首。其中大部分是与业绩目标挂钩的一次性股票奖励。

why.en: Awards enter financial capital only when they vest, through the ownership anchors, so there is no jump here. The event mainly raises human capital (her market price as an executive) and adds +1% to the reputation coefficient.
why.zh: 股权奖励只有在归属后才通过持股锚点进入金融资本，所以这里没有跳升。这个事件主要抬高人力资本（她作为高管的市场价码），口碑系数 +1%。

src.name: Associated Press via News4JAX · AMD's Lisa Su is first woman to top AP's CEO pay analysis

t.en: Agrees to buy Xilinx in an all-stock deal valued at $35 billion
t.zh: 宣布以全股票方式收购赛灵思，交易价值 350 亿美元

summary.en: AMD agreed to acquire Xilinx, the leading maker of programmable chips, paying 1.7234 AMD shares for each Xilinx share. It was by far the largest acquisition in AMD's history, made possible by a share price that had risen more than twentyfold in five years.
summary.zh: AMD 同意收购可编程芯片龙头赛灵思，每股赛灵思换 1.7234 股 AMD 股票。这是 AMD 历史上规模最大的收购，之所以做得成，是因为公司股价五年里涨了二十多倍。

why.en: The stock fell about 4% on the day, which the price series carries. The new shares diluted her ownership fraction when the deal closed in 2022. +1% on the reputation coefficient for the scale of the move.
why.zh: 当天股价下跌约 4%，由股价序列反映。交易在 2022 年完成时增发的新股稀释了她的持股比例。这一步的魄力带来口碑系数 +1%。

src.name: AMD · Press release: AMD to acquire Xilinx

t.en: Becomes the first woman to receive the IEEE Robert N. Noyce Medal
t.zh: 成为首位获得 IEEE 罗伯特·诺伊斯奖章的女性

summary.en: The IEEE gave her its Robert N. Noyce Medal, one of the highest honors in the semiconductor field, for leadership in high-performance processors. No woman had received it before.
summary.zh: IEEE 授予她罗伯特·诺伊斯奖章，这是半导体领域的最高荣誉之一，表彰她在高性能处理器方面的领导作用。此前没有女性获得过这一奖章。

why.en: A pure reputation event that the share price cannot see: +2%. Only the award year is used.
why.zh: 纯声誉事件，股价反映不了：口碑系数 +2%。日期只取获奖年份。

src.name: Wikipedia · IEEE Robert N. Noyce Medal

t.en: Completes the Xilinx acquisition and becomes chair of the board
t.zh: 完成对赛灵思的收购，并出任董事会主席

summary.en: AMD closed the Xilinx purchase, issuing roughly 428 million new shares; at AMD's share price that day the deal was worth close to $50 billion. In the same month Su added the title of board chair to that of chief executive.
summary.zh: AMD 完成对赛灵思的收购，增发约 4.28 亿股新股；按当天股价计算，交易价值接近 500 亿美元。同月，苏姿丰在首席执行官之外兼任董事会主席。

t.en: A short-seller report on AMD's China exposure hits the shares
t.zh: 一份针对 AMD 中国业务的做空报告打压股价

summary.en: Hunterbrook, an investment firm that said it was betting against AMD shares, published a report claiming the company has significant exposure to Chinese customers covered by U.S. export restrictions. AMD had not publicly responded when the report was first covered. The stock fell 7.7% that day and kept falling the next.
summary.zh: 投资机构 Hunterbrook 发布报告，声称 AMD 对受美国出口管制的中国客户有较大业务敞口；该机构同时表明自己在做空 AMD 股票。报告最初被报道时，AMD 尚未公开回应。当天股价下跌 7.7%，次日继续下跌。

why.en: The claims come from a party that profits if the stock falls and have not been confirmed, so no reputation shock is applied (rep = 0). The price move is carried by the stock.
why.zh: 这些说法出自股价下跌便可获利的一方，且尚未得到证实，因此不施加口碑冲击（rep = 0）。股价变动由股票自身反映。

src.name: The Motley Fool · Why AMD stock was plunging on Thursday
